title: Active Inference as a Convex Markov Decision Process
abstract: arXiv:2607.20152v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Active Inference (AIF) frames adaptive behavior as the minimization of expected free energy (EFE), combining epistemic and pragmatic objectives within a single variational principle. We frame AIF as policy optimization and show that, for closed-loop control policies, EFE minimization can be formulated as a convex Markov decision process (MDP). This perspective reveals that policy-dependent reward prediction errors transmit natural gradients of the expected free energy backwards in time rather than up a hierarchy. Finally, we show that coupling world-model learning with policy optimization gives active inference the structure of performative reinforcement learning. Together this places EFE minimization within modern reinforcement learning and optimization theory and opens a route toward principled algorithms for active inference.

translated_title: 主动推理作为凸马尔可夫决策过程
translated_abstract: 主动推理（AIF）将适应性行为框架化为期望自由能（EFE）的最小化，在单一变分原理中结合了认知目标与实用目标。我们将主动推理框架化为策略优化问题，并证明对于闭环控制策略，期望自由能最小化可以表述为一个凸马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。这一视角揭示了依赖策略的奖励预测误差是将期望自由能的自然梯度沿时间向后传递，而非沿层级结构向上传递。最后，我们证明了将世界模型学习与策略优化相耦合，使主动推理具有了表演性强化学习（performative reinforcement learning）的结构。这些结果共同将期望自由能最小化置于现代强化学习与优化理论之中，并为开发有原则的主动推理算法开辟了道路。
tldr: 该论文将主动推理的期望自由能最小化重新表述为凸马尔可夫决策过程，揭示了自然梯度沿时间反向传播的机制，并将其与表演性强化学习联系起来，从而将主动推理纳入现代强化学习与优化理论框架。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates active inference's expected free energy minimization as a convex Markov decision process, reveals that natural gradients propagate backwards in time, and connects it to performative reinforcement learning, thereby placing active inference within modern reinforcement learning and optimization theory.
